name: brain-extract-14-11-26
description: Runs FSL bet on the T1w image with the chosen fractional intensity threshold and optional robust centre estimation (-R) and bias field/neck cleanup (-B), via run_bet.sh and brain_extract.py. The repository has no main file, so brainlife.io cannot start the App as registered, and no container is specified.

inputs.description: Input T1-weighted NIfTI volume to skull-strip.

outputs.description: Brain-extracted (skull-stripped) T1w volume produced by FSL BET.

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0–1). Lower values give a larger brain estimate.
Use BET's robust brain centre estimation (-R).
